title: NASA's Boeing OFT-2 Spacecraft Separation
description: A United Launch Alliance Atlas V rocket with Boeing’s CST-100 Starliner spacecraft launches from Space Launch Complex-41 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida, 6:54 p.m. EDT May 19, 2022. The uncrewed OFT-2 is Starliner’s second flight for NASA’s Commercial Crew Program. The mission will serve as an end-to-end test of the system's capabilities.
